title: BIOmarker driven intensification of cardiovascular RISK factor management in patients with high risk for recurrent cardiovascular EVENTs The BIO-RISK-EVENT Study
official: BIOmarker driven intensification of cardiovascular RISK factor management in patients with high risk for recurrent cardiovascular EVENTs
summary: Main objective: The primary objective of the randomized controlled trial is to evaluate the efficacy (in terms of a composite effect) of intensified residual risk management versus standard guideline treatment.
criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
1. Individuals > 18 years of age
2. Written consent of the participant after being informed
3. Percutaneous coronary intervention (PCI) procedure for acute myocardial infarction (inclusion window: 24 hours to 8 days after PCI)
4. BIO-RISK-EVENT score parameters available
Exclusion criteria:
1. Previous myocardial infarction (prior to the current event leading to enrolment)
2. Women of child-bearing potential
3. Treatment with ciclosporin and strong CYP3A3 inhibitors
4. Treatment with an SGLT2 inhibitor initiated prior to PCI
5. Have had a transplanted organ or awaiting an organ transplant
6. Men whose partners are capable of becoming pregnant may only participate in the clinical study if they commit to using a reliable method of contraception throughout the study duration and for at least 6 months after the end of the trial medication
7. Current treatment with colchicine
8. Current treatment with icosapent ethyl
9. Known allergy to any of the medications being used for intensified treatment or their constituents, or to medications with a similar chemical structure
10. Active known malignancies within the last year, except intraepithelial neoplasm of the prostate, gastrointestinal tract and basal cell carcinoma
11. Acute inflammatory disease (e.g. pneumonia, urinary tract infection, etc.)
12. Known drug or alcohol abuse or psychiatric disorder that, in the opinion of the investigator prevents participation from following the protocol
13. Chronic inflammatory disease (e.g. inflammatory bowel disease, rheumatoid arthritis, etc.)
14. Haemodynamic instability as defined by intravenous administration of catecholamines, calcium sensitisers or phosphodiesterase inhibitors
15. New York Heart Failure (NYHA) Functional Classification Class IV heart failure at baseline
16. Participation in another clinical trial that may affect the results of this study
17. Type 1 diabetes mellitus
18. eGFR <45 mL/min/1.73 m2
19. Liver cirrhosis Childs B or C or other known liver disease preventing the study candidate to participate according to the judgment of the investigator
20. Women who are pregnant or breast-feeding
